verdicts.note: Anxiety among parents during Nigerian university strikes.
No abstract; changing living arrangements among Indian elderly over three decades.
Parental divorce, family structure and Chinese adolescents' academic performance.
Peer review report attached to the Bali patrilocal-marriage study. A shadow record of an already-screened paper.
Second peer review report on the same Bali study.
Men's rigidity in work and family and labour-market gender inequality.
Falls among home-dwelling older Thais.
General descriptive piece on family and household types.

No abstract, but the title crosses a policy with a residence rule: 'When MINIMUM EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENT Meets PATRILOCALITY: Evidence from China, Indonesia, and Ghana'. A compulsory-schooling reform interacted with the residence system in three countries -- a design §4 did not enumerate. Trace for the outcome.

'Family migration in Chinese superstar cities: are FERTILITY INTENTIONS of migrants affected by CO-RESIDENT PARENTS?' The exposure is co-residence, the outcome is fertility intention, and the migrant setting partly breaks the usual selection into co-residence because the parents move to the city.
Family career investments and firms' promotion decisions.

SHORT- AND LONG-DISTANCE HOME-LEAVING AND HOME-RETURNING and their links to other life-course transitions, opening on the observation that co-residence with parents is one of the commonest young-adult arrangements and that many return after living independently. Distance and reversibility together -- the two measurement dimensions §9 is weakest on.
Household structure across LATIN AMERICA AND THE CARIBBEAN amid fertility decline 1960-2020, from 144 country-year census samples. The regional exposure series the frame lacked.
Food-writing essay.
Pregnancy in neurosurgery residency; duplicate.
No abstract; spousal differences in fertility intentions across Chinese family sizes. Chinese intention studies routinely carry co-residence; trace.

THE PROXIMITY CELL'S THIRD RECORD AND ITS BEST DESIGN. Close residence between aging parents and adult daughters against grandchild care and FIRST BIRTHS in Korean KLoSA panel data, using an explicit TWO-STAGE approach BECAUSE grandchild care can only occur after childbirth. That is §3's ordering problem recognised and built into the estimator rather than assumed away. Priority read.

Philippine policy note attributing slowed HOUSEHOLD FORMATION to falling fertility, ageing and LIMITED ACCESS TO AFFORDABLE HOUSING, with extended and multifamily households persisting despite a growing preference for living alone. Wall 1 in a Southeast Asian middle-income setting.
Gender dynamics in family size decisions in rural Ghana; the co-residence tested is SPOUSAL, not parental.
OLG model of grandparental childcare, elderly labour supply and fertility. C.2.a's exposure in a formal model.
Deep-learning system for identifying missing children.
China's low fertility from a social-activity perspective.

DELAYED TRANSITIONS TO ADULTHOOD and ASSISTED REPRODUCTION by education in SPAIN. The registered setting, and it carries the chapter's delay mechanism through to an A.17 outcome -- the clearest statement of what postponement costs biologically, and a cross-reference obligation to A.15 and A.17.
No abstract; fertility and elderly labour supply, published version.
No abstract; legal essay on childcare liberties.
The role of PARENTS in their children's GEOGRAPHICAL MOBILITY in childhood and adulthood. Parental influence on the move itself, which is the decision link 1 models.

Origin-destination comparison of life-course statuses in the transition to adulthood among young Russian-origin Estonians. A migrant-origin comparison of the transition schedule -- close to the second-generation identification strategy Giuliano uses.
Emerging-adulthood mindset and maturity markers in Russia.

GRANDPARENTAL CO-RESIDENCE against NET FERTILITY in MEXICO at three points spanning the whole demographic transition -- 1930 pre-transitional, 1970 growth, 2015 decline -- on census microdata with Poisson and multinomial models. The only record in the frame that estimates this chapter's estimand across PM, FDT and SDT conditions in one country, which bears directly on whether the arrangement's effect is regime-dependent. Priority read.
No abstract; US experience of complex parenthood.
Postpartum fatigue in Indonesia.
Fertility determinants among Emirati university students.

Assessing NATIONAL VERSUS SUBNATIONAL population heterogeneity using the CORESIDENCE Database, arguing national data obscure internal diversity and mislead. That is Wall 3's argument made with this chapter's own exposure variable, and it names the resource to do it with.
Parenthood in Swedish same- and different-sex unions.
Overview of surrogacy. A.17's.
Parenthood under ALS; duplicate theme.
Review essay on obligated care and intergenerational relations in reform China.

No abstract, but the title names both the mechanism and the design: intrahousehold BARGAINING POWER, INTERGENERATIONAL INFLUENCE and women's FERTILITY PREFERENCES in Indonesia, from LONGITUDINAL PANEL data. Trace -- panel data on the extended arm's estimand outside East Asia is rare.

'FAMILY FORMS AND REPRODUCTIVE BEHAVIOUR: a comparative study of NUCLEAR AND EXTENDED HOUSEHOLDS' in Morogoro, Tanzania -- and it states the confounding problem itself, that education and income may explain the apparent extended-household fertility premium. Sub-Saharan setting; the extended arm has almost nothing there.
Fertility intentions among Chinese adults from a national survey, examining multiple underlying factors under the three-child policy. Whether co-residence is among them is not visible.
No abstract; concluding thoughts on the regulation of parenting.
Neighbourhood-level spatial determinants of low birth rates in South Korea, MGWR. Sub-national fertility variation without an arrangement exposure.

'WHO ACHIEVES RESIDENTIAL INDEPENDENCE? Living Arrangements of NEVER-MARRIED Young Adults in Urban China, 2003-2018' in Population and Development Review. Restricting to the never-married isolates the pre-launch configuration cleanly -- which is exactly the sample restriction §6 said would usually be invisible -- in the setting where the extended arm dominates. Priority read.
Parents among adult psychiatric inpatients.

MULTICHANNEL SEQUENCE ANALYSIS of early mid-life trajectories against ULTIMATE CHILDLESSNESS in Finland and Belgium, with delays in RESIDENTIAL INDEPENDENCE among the channels. The sequence method §3 wants, carried through to a completed-fertility endpoint rather than a timing one. Priority read.

Transitions to motherhood in SPAIN: first union, LEAVING HOME, economic independence and employment against the PROBABILITY OF MOTHERHOOD, with attention to timing and order. The registered setting, the registered mechanism, and both links estimated together. Priority read.
Health decline triggering residential transitions among older Europeans, comparing parents and childless individuals.

Cross-European comparison of IDEATIONS AND INTENTIONS about the timing of EXIT FROM THE PARENTAL HOME, cohabitation, marriage and parenthood. Intentions about the arrangement itself, which no other record measures directly.
Depression among pregnant adolescents in Tanzania.
Legal recognition of caregiving by aunts in Taiwan.
Dataset of Black Americans born before emancipation in the 1900 census -- the emancipation homonym in a data resource.
No abstract; youth transition pathways in Norway. One of four country chapters in the same comparative volume.
No abstract; prolonged transitions into adulthood in Germany. Same volume.
No abstract; protracted and diversified transition pathways in the UK. Same volume.

Swiss youth transitions covering school-to-work, HOUSING (LEAVING HOME) and domestic transitions including PARENTHOOD, with gendered life courses. The one chapter of the four whose abstract confirms both links are in scope.
